SELECT r.id, r.name, r.vehicle_id as vehicleId, v.plate_number as vehiclePlate, v.brand as vehicleBrand, v.driver_name as driverName, r.station_count as stationCount, r.total_passenger as totalPassenger, r.capacity, r.occupancy_rate as occupancyRate, r.total_distance as totalDistance, r.estimated_time as estimatedTime, r.departure_time as departureTime, r.status, r.color, r.create_time as createTime FROM biz_route r LEFT JOIN biz_vehicle v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE r.deleted = 0
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.name ASC

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.vehicle_id as vehicleId, v.plate_number as vehiclePlate, v.brand as vehicleBrand, v.driver_name as driverName, r.station_count as stationCount, r.total_passenger as totalPassenger, r.capacity, r.occupancy_rate as occupancyRate, r.total_distance as totalDistance, r.estimated_time as estimatedTime, r.departure_time as departureTime, r.status, r.color, r.create_time as createTime FROM biz_route r LEFT JOIN biz_vehicle v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0
